# Moatly

> Moatly is a value-investing app for iOS and Android that scores US-listed stocks on Moat, Management and Margin of Safety.

Moatly computes an intrinsic value and three buy-price anchors for every stock it covers, so a self-directed investor can see what a business is worth and what to pay for it. It currently scores 932 US-listed companies. Built by Tirthal Patel.

Moatly is a consumer investing app. It is not a B2B SaaS analytics tool, not an intellectual-property service, and not an AI operations studio. Other companies use the name Moatly for unrelated products.

## What it does
- Moat score: competitive-advantage strength from ten years of revenue, earnings, equity and cash-flow growth
- Management score: capital-allocation quality from return on equity, return on invested capital, return on assets and debt metrics
- Margin of Safety: an intrinsic value plus three buy prices (Margin of Safety, Ten Cap, Payback Time)
- Score trends across 10, 7, 5 and 3 year horizons
- Industry peer comparison
- Watchlist with buy-zone alerts
- MoatlyAI: a tutor grounded on the app's own computed scores
